# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.2 Worker 4: celestial hooks, events and crises (oe_cel_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v112_celestial_events.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Four own hooks, appended to the vanilla on_actions (no vanilla file is overridden).
on_game_start = {
	on_actions = { oe_cel_init_io_policies }
}

on_ruler_death_delayed = {
	on_actions = { oe_cel_on_fanwang_ruler_death }
}

on_character_death = {
	on_actions = { oe_cel_on_dispatched_prince_death }
}

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = { oe_cel_yearly_pulse }
}

# Gives the four v11.2 Middle Kingdom laws their default policies at the start.
oe_cel_init_io_policies = {
	trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
	effect = {
		oe_cel_init_default_io_policies = yes
	}
}

# root = the country whose ruler died. A princely fief's overlord (the throne) is asked whether the heir succeeds.
oe_cel_on_fanwang_ruler_death = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1200
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
		overlord ?= {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev9_cd }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = oe_cel_fief
		overlord ?= {
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_ev9_cd years = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_dead_fief value = scope:oe_cel_fief }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.9
		}
	}
}

# root = country, scope:target = the character who died. A prince sent out by the throne carries var:oe_cel_dispatched_prince.
oe_cel_on_dispatched_prince_death = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1200
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = { has_variable = oe_cel_dispatched_prince }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target = {
			var:oe_cel_dispatched_prince ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.10
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Once a year, for the country holding the Mandate only (every other country stops at the trigger).
oe_cel_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1200
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}
	effect = {
		oe_cel_init_default_io_policies = yes
		oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes

		# first year with the Mandate
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_mandate_seen }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_mandate_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_debate_wait years = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes
						oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = yes
					}
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.5
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.1
			}
		}

		# staged gaituguiliu: one marked subject a year, when its timer has run out
		random_subject = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_cel_gtgl_marked
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_gtgl_due }
			}
			save_scope_as = oe_cel_gtgl_done
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_cel_gtgl_done
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			annex_country = { country = scope:oe_cel_gtgl_done reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.15
		}

		# revocation crisis: won when the rebel fief is gone or no longer a princely fief under us, lost when the
		# ten years are over or the fief has left
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_cel_crisis_active
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_rebel_fief }
						NOT = { var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= { num_locations > 0 } }
						var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= {
							is_subject_of = root
							NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang }
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.7
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_crisis_due }
						var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= { NOT = { is_subject_of = root } }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.8
			}
		}

		# the debate on government and its verdict
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_debate_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_debate_wait }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.18
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_cel_debate_done
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_verdict_due }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_verdict_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.19
		}

		# the Mandate wanes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev20_cd }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				NOT = { current_celestial_authority = { value = 20 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_ev20_cd years = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.20
		}

		# treasure fleets
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_treasure_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_treasure_hegemony }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.21
		}

		# easter eggs
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_cel_twin_phoenix_ready
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_twin_phoenix_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.22
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_cel_zone_fusang
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_elysia_met_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				OR = {
					AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia } }
					AND = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia } }
					AND = { country_exists = c:FEO c:FEO = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.23
		}

		# v12.0 Celestial 2.0: Nanyang / Indian Ocean / Western Regions / Nurgan frontier milestones (.26-.29)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev26_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				current_year >= 1400
				oe_cel_controls_nanyang_hub = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.26
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev27_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				OR = {
					international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_treasure_hegemony }
					has_variable = oe_cel_treasure_done
					has_advance = oe_cel_adv_sihai_duhu
				}
				OR = {
					location:kozhikode = { has_owner = yes is_discovered_by = root }
					location:kotte = { has_owner = yes is_discovered_by = root }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.27
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev28_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				current_year >= 1400
				oe_cel_controls_western_regions_hub = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.28
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev29_done }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd }
				current_year >= 1405
				oe_cel_controls_nurgan_hub = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_yearly_ev_cd value = 1 months = 11 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.29
		}
	}
}
